I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.
For godly sorrow produces repentance to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

people.name: Amnon
people.line: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom

people.name: Tamar
people.line: David's daughter, raped by her half-brother Amnon

translations.web: Amnon was so troubled that he became sick because of his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her.
translations.bsb: Amnon was sick with frustration over his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed implausible for him to do anything to her.
translations.kjv: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her.
translations.asv: And Amnon was so vexed that he fell sick because of his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything unto her.
